hooks.command: if curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3141/; then echo 'Anki is open. Once, at the start of this session, check the Remember The Milk list "Anki inbox" for incomplete tasks; if there are any, empty it with the anki-notes skill and report in one line. If it is empty, say nothing about it.'; fi
